name: Schastlivyj chelovek
source:
I’m [name], and I believe everyone starts life with a treasure chest inside. When you love, you spend some coins – and when you’re loved back, you’re paid in happiness...

[From [url=https://elilit.itch.io/happy-men]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我是[name]，我相信每个人的人生都是从一个宝箱开始的。当你爱的时候，你会花费一些硬币——而当你被爱时，你会得到幸福的回报……

[来自[url=https://elilit.itch.io/happy-men]Itch.io[/url]]
